description: This file contains the Version2Header class responsible for retrieving version information from SVN and generating a header file (svnversion.h) with version and Git hash details.

classes.name: Version2Header
classes.description: Main class that interacts with SVN to generate version header files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the program, processes command-line arguments, retrieves SVN info, and calls writeFile.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Generates 'svnversion.h' with version and git hash information.
